taxonomy_note: Compatibility planning lens only, not a normative cross-domain mapping. Final root-cause taxonomy may differ or remain unassigned.
native_context: MASVS-PLATFORM; distinguish web rendering from native capability exposure

controls.boundary: Android WebView content-to-native capability boundary — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Trace trusted/untrusted navigation, JavaScript bridge registration, message channels, origin rules and native operations. Record Android/WebView version and frame scope.
controls.controlled_verification: Use owned local content to compare the intended trusted page with an untrusted navigation/frame reaching an inert native operation. Inspect which origin/frame supplied the message at the native consumer and whether navigation changes the trust context.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: JavaScript enabled or a bridge method existing is not sufficient. A bridge inaccessible to attacker-controlled content may defeat the path; top-level URL checks may not describe subframe/message behavior.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Restrict navigation/bridge capabilities and enforce supported caller-origin/frame checks at sensitive operations. Retest intended web content, untrusted navigation and the evidenced frame/channel path.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
